title: Allow resizing floating Meta+V clipboard popup
line: The Meta+V clipboard popup can now be resized by dragging its edges, and it opens at the size you picked the next time.
explanation: The Meta+V popup had no resize handles, so the only way to make it bigger was KWin's Meta+right-drag, and every time it opened it was resized back to a default based on the screen size. Nate said on the bug that allowing a resize without saving it is a bug, and that the size should be saved. The popup now starts a system resize when its frame edges are dragged (with the matching resize cursors, like the system tray popup), has a minimum size of 15x10 grid units, and when it closes after the user resized it (by edge or Meta+right-drag) it stores that size in plasmashellstaterc ([klipper][Popup]) and opens at that size afterwards, capped to the screen.

commits.message:
klipper: Make the Meta+V popup resizable and remember its size

The popup could only be resized with Meta+right-drag, and it went back
to its default size every time it opened. Let its edges be dragged like
the system tray popup and save the size the user picks in state config.

BUG: 496475

media.caption: Master: dragging the popup's left edge to the left does nothing
Patched: the same left-edge drag widens the popup, showing more of each entry
Master: after widening it with Meta+right-drag and closing it, the next Meta+V opens it narrow again
Patched: after resizing and closing, the next Meta+V opens it at the size picked before
